_: Canonical file-size limits. Formerly prose in .claude/rules/code-style.md §1 and eight other hand-maintained copies. Enforced by .claude/hooks/check-file-size-guard.mjs (pre-commit + CI) and pinned into .coderabbit.yaml by check-file-size-guard.test.mjs — CodeRabbit cannot follow a pointer, so its copy is KEPT and machine-verified rather than deleted. Prose may explain WHY a limit exists; it must not restate a number from here.

rules.note: Test files are relaxed, not exempt. Keyed on the BASENAME so the extension stays an open set (.ts, .tsx, .mjs all count) — an enumerated extension list had already drifted once by missing .mjs. The great majority comply, so the cap is achievable and the violators are drift rather than evidence the cap is wrong; they are grandfathered below. Ratios are an OPEN set and are NOT stated here: three successive commits shipped one wrong, each measured before that commit's own new files landed (code-style.md §10 cl.2). Derive with `node .claude/hooks/check-file-size-guard.mjs --stats`, which is executed by the same code that enforces. An earlier attempt embedded the one-liner here instead; it carried an unbound placeholder and threw when run as written — a derivation that looks checkable and is not is worse than the literal it replaced.

EXCEPTION, applied by grandfathering rather than by a code branch: a migration whose content is a single unsplittable DDL object (one CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION plus its GRANT/COMMENT/DROP boilerplate) cannot be split — a plpgsql body does not span files, and single-function SECURITY DEFINER redefinitions run ~300-330 lines. Such files are listed in `baseline` below. The limit stays strict so a genuinely multi-statement migration that COULD be split by concern is still flagged.

Defined by the `'use server'` directive, NOT by living in an actions/ folder — a folder-based rule gets it wrong in BOTH directions: most over-limit files under an actions/ directory lack the directive entirely (pure helpers, several split out to obey THIS rule and saying so in their header), while several files that DO declare it sit outside any actions/ directory — note `settings/actions.ts` is a FILE named actions.ts, not a directory, and a path-substring test conflates the two. Ratios are an OPEN set and are NOT stated here: three successive commits shipped one wrong, each measured before that commit's own new files landed (code-style.md §10 cl.2). Derive with `node .claude/hooks/check-file-size-guard.mjs --stats`, which is executed by the same code that enforces. An earlier attempt embedded the one-liner here instead; it carried an unbound placeholder and threw when run as written — a derivation that looks checkable and is not is worse than the literal it replaced.

_excludeGlobs: scripts/ and apps/web/scripts/ are the long-standing `scripts/ directory exclusion`. packages/db/migrations/ has been FROZEN since 2026-07-11 and carries false history; it must never be graded or fixed (13 of its files exceed 300). packages/db/src/types.ts is GENERATED by `supabase gen types` (1806 lines) — the generator owns its length. apps/web/e2e/** is deliberately NOT excluded: only *.test.* / *.spec.* BASENAMES are exempt, and the superseded code-reviewer suppression was explicit that test-INFRA helpers (setup.ts, seed.ts, shared helpers/*.ts) take the ordinary 200-line utility cap. Excluding the directory would silently reverse that decision; the over-limit helpers are grandfathered in `baseline` instead, where they stay visible and can only shrink.
_coverage: COVERAGE BOUNDARY, stated because an unstated one is the drift this file exists to stop: `.mjs` matches no rule, so every `.claude/hooks/*.mjs` guard — including the one that enforces this file — is ungraded. That is deliberate (hook scripts are infrastructure, and the carve-out previously lived only in agent-memory prose), but it is a gap in coverage rather than an entry in excludeGlobs, and the two are not the same thing. Their co-located *.test.mjs files ARE graded, under the test-file rule.
